subject: Hosted API: remap of usage bands & consolidation of monthly commit for Retailify
messages:
From: Elena Gomez <elena@retailify.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 30 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Consolidating commits and remapping usage bands

Hi Marcus,

Thanks again for the QBR last week — the data you shared was super helpful. Two items popped up from our side that we'd like to align on before renewal:

1) We currently run two separate hosted API commits across Retailify Search and Retailify Assist. Combined they average ~850k billable tokens/month, but the usage profile is spiky (search has steady mid-throughput; Assist has bursty peak traffic tied to campaigns).

2) We want to consolidate to a single monthly commit and remap the usage bands so that we have a larger baseline commit and a more generous burst window for Assist (it typically needs 3–4x baseline for short bursts).

Can Redwood provide a recommended mapping (monthly commit target + per-route rate limits) along with an amendment draft we can share with procurement? I've attached a CSV showing the last 90 days of token distribution. Our renewal is scheduled for mid‑August, and procurement will need the amendment and final pricing to issue a PO.

Also, Oliver (cc'd) will flag any EU-region constraints — we may need a parallel rate limit in eu-west.

Thanks,
Elena

--
Elena Gomez
Head of Product, Retailify
elena@retailify.com
+1 415-555-0123
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Elena Gomez <elena@retailify.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 30 Jun 2027 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Consolidating commits and remapping usage bands

Elena — great summary, and thanks for the CSV. Quick read-through suggests a clear path to simplify billing and reduce unit cost while protecting Assist's burst profile. High-level proposal:

- Consolidated monthly commit: 1,200,000 billable tokens/month (this replaces the two existing commits).
- Burst window: allow up to 4x baseline for select Assist routes for 15-minute windows, auto-throttled by policy to preserve latency SLOs.
- Rate limits:
  - Search read routes: 65 req/s per deployment (steady-state optimized).
  - Assist chat (short-turn): 110 req/s with burst policy above for 15m windows.
- Term: 12 months (option to renew early at current pricing); prepay discount if Retailify prepays for 6+ months (we can propose 7% off).

I've drafted an initial amendment (PDF attached) that maps the numbers above to your existing contract lines and includes a clause for staged rollout (canary to 10% traffic for first week). If you're comfortable, I'll loop in Legal to prepare a docusign-able amendment and have Karthik run the discount and rebate numbers for the renewal quote.

Action items:
- Marcus: finalize amendment + send to Legal (EOD Thu)
- Karthik: provide line-item pricing and prepay scenarios by Fri
- Monica: confirm ops checklist for rollout (cache keys, batching, recommended route tags)

Cheers,
Marcus

--
Marcus Lin
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwood.com | +1 650-555-3344
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
To: Elena Gomez <elena@retailify.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 01 Jul 2027 08:41:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Consolidating commits and remapping usage bands

Elena, Marcus — adding the ops perspective. A couple operational notes we should bake into the amendment and rollout plan:

- Prefix/KV caching: Assist has significant repetition in session prompts; enabling prefix caching on the Assist routes should cut billable tokens by ~18% (we'll run a quick eval once the routing tags are in place).
- Batching/slot sizing: For Search, a modest increase in batch size reduces per-token latency cost without impacting 95th percentile latency; we'll recommend target batch size and max latency budget per route in the ops checklist.
- Canary plan: Recommend a 3-stage canary: 1% (24h) -> 10% (72h) -> 100% (monitor 7 days). We'll include rollback triggers (error rate, 95p latency, regen rate).

I've flagged a HubSpot ticket with the usage split and the deployments that will need the new route tags: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/123456/deal/4891. Marcus — I'm happy to draft the ops appendix and the rollout checklist; suggest we attach it as an exhibit to the amendment.

Monica

--
Monica Patel
Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference
monica.patel@redwood.com
From: Elena Gomez <elena@retailify.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Cc: Oliver Park <oliver.park@retailify.com>, procurement@retailify.com
Date: Fri, 02 Jul 2027 15:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Consolidating commits and remapping usage bands

Thanks all — this looks good and aligned with our internal goals. A few procurement/term asks before we sign:

- Retailify prefers a 12-month firm term with a one-time prepay option. If we prepay 6 months upfront, we can accept a 7% discount; if we prepay 12 months, we'd expect 10% off. Please include both prepay scenarios in the amendment.
- We need explicit rate limit clauses for eu-west region (same per-route ceilings, but separate burst windows so we don't impact EU compliance). Oliver, can you confirm specifics on EU traffic with Marcus?
- Procurement needs the final amendment and a DocuSign link by July 12 to meet our PO timeline.

If you can incorporate the ops appendix Monica mentioned and provide the two prepay scenarios, I can route this to procurement (procurement@retailify.com) and get the PO issued.

Thanks,
Elena

--
Elena Gomez
Head of Product, Retailify
